Method is available by Personal token, Service token
Adds items to the specified supply draft.
The method works on the principle of atomicity: - if all skus are successfully validated, all items will be added to the draft. The response will return {"results":[]} - if at least one sku is not validated, no items will be added to the draft. The response will return a list of invalid skus

get.description:
Method is available by Personal token, Service token
The method returns information about discrepancies between the declared and actual item quantity in the supply.
Available for supplies accepted no more than one year ago.

**Discrepancy types:**

Discrepancy upwards:

1. Excess of items with the declared SKU: - `"discrepancyType": "surplus"` - `"discrepancyLabel": "surplus"` 2. Excess of items with a SKU that does not match the declared one: - `"discrepancyType": "surplus"` - `"discrepancyLabel": "re-sorting"` Discrepancy downwards:

1. Missing items: - `"discrepancyType": "shortage"` - `"discrepancyLabel": "shortage"` 2. Some SKUs do not match the declared ones: - `"discrepancyType": "shortage"` - `"discrepancyLabel": "re-sorting"`
Request limit per one seller account: | Period | Limit | Interval | Burst | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 min | 1 request | 1 min | 1 request |
